notes.title: 1.0.1 Bugfix Release
notes.content:
- The jump animation has been updated.
- Fixed an issue where obstacles were awkwardly cut off.
- The dying message now appears with a slight delay.

notes.title: The Madness Trap Trek You've Been Waiting For is Finally Here!
notes.content:
Finally! The Madness Trap Trek is live! 🎉

Hey everyone!

It’s here at last! The Madness Trap Trek has officially launched on Steam today!

For all you adventurers out there, escaping the Madness Trap might seem easy at first… but if you make it all the way to the final stage, you’ll see things take a challenging turn! 😉 Jump right in and see if you have what it takes to conquer the madness!

We truly value your feedback, so please share your thoughts and experiences with us. And don’t forget to connect with other players as you all unravel the mysteries of the maze together!

We’re waiting for you in-game. Enjoy the journey! 😊

Thank you!
From the Ilsim Team
